notes: The 30 major monster groups with nine-stage progression from the Monster Classification & Guild System bible v1.0 (user PDF). DRAFT: Canon section 6 proposal in 13_Production/monster_guild_integration.md. These are naming and progression templates; no stats. familyKeys is our crosswalk to Data/Monsters/species.json (empty = the game has no matching family yet). Stage 7 to 9 names (Lord, King, Emperor) are species labels, not enemy hierarchy (Canon 4d).

conditionKinds.text: Surviving encounters, hunting, defeating rivals or completing milestones.
Natural growth, life-cycle changes or long dormancy.
Absorbing magical energy, elemental power, souls or monster cores.
Prolonged exposure to volcanic, frozen, abyssal, sacred, corrupted or high-mana regions.
Consuming rare minerals, plants, cores, bloodlines or crafted catalysts.
Protecting a territory, leading a colony or surviving a catastrophe (never defeating the player).
Unlocking a latent bloodline, forgotten memory, ancient form or unique ability.

patterns.text: One main route, such as Goblin > Hobgoblin > Goblin King.
A creature chooses a path, such as Orc > Berserker, Shaman or Guardian.
A rare condition produces an exceptional form, such as Ancient Dragon > Awakened Dragon God.

specializationFamilies.text: Direct combat, weapons, armour, physical damage.
Spellcasting, elemental powers, curses and rituals.
Stealth, ambush, mobility, poison and precision.
Command, coordination, tactics and group buffs.

groups.name: Goblins
groups.identity: Intelligent, adaptable, tribal and resourceful humanoids.
branches: Warrior: Goblin Fighter > Hobgoblin Guard > Goblin Champion
Magic: Goblin Shaman > High Shaman > Arch Shaman
Stealth: Goblin Rogue > Assassin > Shadow Goblin
Engineering: Tinkerer > Siege Engineer > Master Inventor
groups.signatureAbilities: Scouting, traps, scavenging, engineering, ambushes and improvised weapons.
groups.society: Nests, camps, villages and fortified warrens. Strength comes from numbers, traps, adaptability and clever specialists.

groups.name: Orcs
groups.identity: Powerful, militaristic humanoids organized into clans and warbands.
branches: Berserker: Orc > Berserker > Blood Berserker > War Berserker
Warrior: Orc Fighter > Elite Warrior > Orc Champion
Magic: Orc Shaman > High Shaman > Warlock
Beastmaster: Beast Tamer > War Beast Commander
groups.signatureAbilities: War cries, heavy weapons, clan tactics, beast mounts and battle magic.
groups.society: Clan confederations, fortress states or empires. Leadership is earned through strength, strategy and victories.

groups.name: Trolls
groups.identity: Large territorial creatures with strong regeneration and resilience.
branches: Stone: Stone Troll > Mountain > Living Mountain
Combat: War Troll > Berserker Troll > Destroyer Troll
Magic: Troll Shaman > Earth Troll Mage
Leadership: Elder Troll > Chieftain > Troll King
groups.signatureAbilities: Regeneration, ambush, crushing blows, terrain adaptation and endurance.
groups.society: Lairs, caves, bridges, ruins or wilderness territories. Fire, acid or specific magic can counter regeneration.

groups.name: Ogres
groups.identity: Massive humanoids with exceptional strength and durability.
branches: Brute: Ogre > Heavy Ogre > Giant Brute
Armoured: Ogre > Iron Ogre > Fortress Ogre
Magic: Ogre Mage > Arcane Ogre > High Ogre Magus
Leadership: Chieftain > Ogre King > Colossus King
groups.signatureAbilities: Siege strength, heavy clubs, armour breaking, throwing attacks and intimidation.
groups.society: Small clans, mercenary companies or fortress tribes. They value food, territory, trophies and strength.

groups.name: Hobgoblin-kind
groups.identity: Disciplined, organized humanoids with a strong military culture; intentionally distinct from Goblins.
branches: Knight: Knight > Royal Knight > Grand Marshal
Magic: Battle Mage > War Strategist > Arch Tactician
groups.signatureAbilities: Formation tactics, shields, siege craft, command auras and battlefield discipline.
groups.society: Legions, city-states, military republics or empires.

groups.name: Dragons
groups.identity: Ancient scaled creatures with powerful bodies, breath weapons and often innate magic.
branches: Ice: Frost > Glacier > Absolute Zero Dragon
groups.signatureAbilities: Breath weapons, flight, elemental resistance, hoards, territorial magic and ancient memory.
groups.society: Solitary sovereigns, ancestral houses or loose flights. Their lairs often alter the surrounding ecosystem.

groups.name: Wyverns
groups.identity: Aerial draconic predators, typically lighter and more specialized for flight.
groups.signatureAbilities: Aerial dives, tail strikes, venom, flock tactics and nesting territory control.
groups.society: Nest in cliffs, ruins and mountain ranges. Some form flocks under a dominant alpha.

groups.name: Drakes
groups.identity: Ground-oriented or heavily built draconic creatures.
groups.signatureAbilities: Armour, charges, burrowing, elemental glands and ground-shaking attacks.
groups.society: Commonly defend mineral-rich caves, canyons and volcanic valleys.

groups.name: Basilisks and Gorgons
groups.identity: Reptilian monsters whose gaze, venom or aura can petrify or weaken prey.
groups.signatureAbilities: Petrifying gaze, venom, ambush, stone scales and territory denial.
groups.society: Lairs may contain petrified victims, mineral deposits and dangerous sight-line hazards.

groups.name: Hydras and Serpent Beasts
groups.identity: Multi-headed or giant serpentine creatures with regeneration and area control.
groups.signatureAbilities: Multiple simultaneous attacks, head regeneration, constriction, venom and elemental breath.
groups.society: Dominate swamps, lakes, river valleys and ancient waterways. Cutting heads may trigger different outcomes by species.

groups.name: Undead
groups.identity: Creatures animated by necromancy, curses, lingering souls or supernatural forces.
groups.signatureAbilities: Soul drain, necromancy, fear, reassembly, curses and command over lesser undead.
groups.society: Factions may be ruled by necromancers, liches, death knights or a shared death-consciousness.

groups.name: Demons
groups.identity: Infernal or abyssal supernatural beings with varied forms and hierarchies.
groups.signatureAbilities: Hellfire, contracts, corruption, summoning, possession and fear auras.
groups.society: Feudal courts, war legions, cult networks or competing infernal houses.

groups.name: Spirits and Wraiths
groups.identity: Ethereal beings linked to souls, places, memories or natural forces.
groups.signatureAbilities: Intangibility, possession, fear, soul effects, illusions and spiritual projection.
groups.society: Bound to shrines, forests, battlefields, objects or ancestral bloodlines.

groups.name: Vampires
groups.identity: Blood-dependent supernatural predators with bloodline abilities and social houses.
groups.signatureAbilities: Blood regeneration, heightened senses, charm, mist form and bloodline magic.
groups.society: Houses, courts, covens and dynasties with strict bloodline politics.

groups.name: Fallen and Celestial Monsters
groups.identity: Radiant, divine or fallen supernatural beings with sacred or corrupted celestial power.
groups.signatureAbilities: Purification, barriers, flight, radiant attacks, blessings and anti-undead powers.
groups.society: Hierarchical orders, sanctuaries or fallen hosts. Their goals need not always align with mortals.

groups.name: Beast Monsters
groups.identity: Animal-like monsters with strong instincts, physical abilities and ecological roles.
branches: Bear: Bear > Giant Bear > Earthshaker Bear
Lion: Lion > King Lion > Solar Lion
Cat: Wildcat > Shadow Panther > Phantom Panther
Hybrid: Chimera > Greater Chimera > Mythical Chimera
groups.signatureAbilities: Pack tactics, scent tracking, pounce, natural armour and territorial instincts.
groups.society: Packs, prides, dens and migration routes. Alpha status may be earned through challenge or age.

groups.name: Insects
groups.identity: Colony-based creatures with castes and specialized biological roles.
branches: Ant: Worker > Soldier > Elite Soldier > General > Queen
Beetle: Beetle > Armoured Beetle > Colossus Beetle
Wasp: Wasp > Hunter Wasp > Royal Wasp
Spider-like line: Broodling > Giant Weaver > Broodmother
Mantis: Mantis > Blade Mantis > Death Mantis
groups.signatureAbilities: Hive coordination, pheromones, armour, venom, burrowing and caste abilities.
groups.society: Colonies with workers, soldiers, scouts, breeders, royal guards, queens and empresses.

groups.name: Arachnids
groups.identity: Spider- and scorpion-like monsters treated as a distinct family for richer taxonomy.
groups.signatureAbilities: Webs, venom, ambush, burrowing, climbing and multi-limb attacks.
groups.society: Solitary hunters, nesting colonies or broodmother-led territories.

groups.name: Avian Monsters
groups.identity: Flying creatures with aerial mobility, keen senses and sky-territory control.
branches: Eagle: Giant Eagle > Royal Eagle > Sky Emperor
Griffin: Lesser Griffin > Greater Griffin > Royal Griffin
groups.signatureAbilities: Flight, wind manipulation, dive attacks, talons, aerial scouting and rebirth for selected species.
groups.society: Cliffs, high forests, floating islands and storm peaks.

groups.name: Magical Plant Monsters
groups.identity: Living plants that hunt, defend territories and absorb magical energy.
branches: Vine: Vine Beast > Thorn Monster > Thorn Lord
Tree: Living Tree > Treant > Ancient Treant
Fungal: Mushroom Creature > Spore Lord > Mycelium Sovereign
Floral: Magical Flower > Bloom Guardian > Eternal Blossom
groups.signatureAbilities: Regeneration, roots, poison spores, camouflage, pollen and environmental control.
groups.society: Forests, root networks, fungal minds or guardians of sacred groves.

groups.name: Golems
groups.identity: Artificial magical beings powered by cores, runes and command systems.
branches: Elemental Core > Elemental Golem > Supreme Golem
Mechanical Golem > War Machine > Ancient Automaton
groups.signatureAbilities: Core protection, runic barriers, heavy strikes, self-repair and command obedience.
groups.society: Made, awakened, inherited or discovered in ruins. Their core determines much of their capability.

groups.name: Elementals
groups.identity: Beings formed from pure elemental energy.
branches: Light: Radiance > Holy Light > Celestial Light
groups.signatureAbilities: Elemental transformation, area control, energy absorption and resistance to own element.
groups.society: Gather around nexuses, shrines, storms, volcanoes and ley lines.

groups.name: Magical Constructs and Automata
groups.identity: Artificial beings made through engineering, enchanted machinery and ancient technology.
groups.signatureAbilities: Self-repair, tactical learning, weapon integration, network coordination and modular upgrades.
groups.society: Follow creator commands, ancient protocols or emergent artificial intelligence.

groups.name: Crystal Monsters
groups.identity: Living mineral creatures that absorb and store magical energy.
groups.signatureAbilities: Energy reflection, magical amplification, crystal armour and resonance attacks.
groups.society: Colonies grow around ley lines and rare mineral deposits. Their shards are valuable crafting materials.

groups.name: Slimes and Amorphous Monsters
groups.identity: Shape-changing creatures with flexible bodies and absorption abilities.
groups.signatureAbilities: Absorption, division, regeneration, mimicry, engulfing and material adaptation.
groups.society: Solitary, clustered or connected through a shared core network. Their division and fusion rules need clear limits.

groups.name: Giants and Titans
groups.identity: Enormous humanoid beings tied to terrain, weather and primordial strength.
groups.signatureAbilities: Earthquakes, colossal strength, weather control, terrain destruction and giant weaponry.
groups.society: Clans, mountain holds, ancient courts or nomadic titan families.

groups.name: Aquatic and Sea Monsters
groups.identity: Creatures of rivers, lakes, oceans and abyssal depths.
groups.signatureAbilities: Water manipulation, pressure resistance, underwater ambush, currents and ocean storms.
groups.society: Reef kingdoms, trench empires, migrating shoals or isolated leviathan territories.

groups.name: Fae and Fairy Monsters
groups.identity: Magical beings connected to nature, illusion, enchantment and ancient bargains.
groups.signatureAbilities: Illusions, nature magic, charms, enchantments, bargains and dimensional travel.
groups.society: Courts, seasonal houses, pacts and strict rules of hospitality.

groups.name: Mythical Hybrids
groups.identity: Creatures combining traits from multiple species or magical lineages.
groups.signatureAbilities: Mixed attacks, multiple senses, adaptable anatomy and unpredictable evolution.
groups.society: Naturally occurring, magically created or engineered. Their ancestry should be recorded explicitly.

groups.name: Cosmic and Void Monsters
groups.identity: Beings from beyond the ordinary world, tied to space, dimensions and primordial forces.
groups.signatureAbilities: Dimensional travel, space distortion, gravity manipulation, reality corruption and cosmic perception.
groups.society: Incomprehensible, solitary or linked through a shared void intelligence. Their presence can alter world rules.
